Business Summary#

A hidden gem in the heart of a downtown area in Eastern Iowa that is located near performance theatres, convention centers, and hotels. The Business offers a full bar and dine-in menu, 4 days a week.  

Staffing:  1 Full-Time, 6 Part-Time

Facilities:  1,670 sq. ft. of leased space in a historic building with seating for 60 people. The property features a contemporary design and updated kitchen equipment.

Competition: This business is in a prime downtown location.

Growth & Expansion: Additional operating hours would increase profits.

Reason for Selling: The owner's daughter is leaving for college.
